inputSchemaCoverage: Command envelopes and documented nested fields; adapter, revision, applicability and physical validation remain authoritative.

operations.description: Verify complete bytes, UTF-8 JSON, hash, saved metadata and expected archive revision before replacing the case archive.

transferId.description: Opaque page-lifetime identity returned by the matching list/begin operation.

sideEffects: Atomically replaces the saved case collection and invalidates prior case IDs.
limitations: Default registry holds at most 4 transfers and 100000000 retained bytes in total; these are not peak-heap guarantees.
Transfer IDs are temporary. Release retained buffers after use.
Canonical base64 pages contain at most 65536 decoded bytes; hashes cover complete source bytes.
Full nested archive/result/view validation is performed by the service; no physical result is recomputed.
